references.text: In contrast to verse 24, when the Israelites disobeyed Moses and left some manna until morning, it became full of maggots and smelled bad. This shows the contrast between disobedience and obedience to God's command.
Moses gave the command that the people followed in verse 24, to set aside manna for the next day because of the Sabbath.
The manna was also kept in a jar as a reminder for future generations, showing God's miraculous ability to preserve the manna from decay.
The book of Hebrews mentions the jar of manna that was kept in the ark of the covenant and connects this to the miraculous preservation of the manna.
